chunks: Al-ʿAlāʾ narrated from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:

In the book of ʿAlī عليه السلام: "The child does not take anything from the wealth of his father, while the father may take from the wealth of his child whatever he wishes. And he may have relations with the bondwoman of his son, if the son has not had relations with her."

key_terms.الْوَلَدَ: the child or offspring in relation to the father

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith in the book of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام say about a father taking from his child’s wealth?
ai.summary: This hadith records a legal ruling attributed to the book of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام concerning financial rights between father and child. It states that the father has authority to take from the wealth of his child, and it also mentions a ruling regarding the bondwoman of the son under a stated condition.
